policy.name: Puducherry New Industrial Policy 2016, implemented through schemes 'Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to capital intensive industries' (G.O. Ms. No. 2/Ind.&Com./A6/2017) and '... Various incentives' (G.O. Ms. No. 4/Ind.&Com./A6/2017)
policy.order_no: G.O. Ms. No. 7/2016/Ind.A dated 04-10-2016 (policy); G.O. Ms. No. 2/Ind.&Com./A6/2017 and G.O. Ms. No. 4/Ind.&Com./A6/2017 dated 02-05-2017 (schemes, Gazette Part II No. 33 dated 06-06-2017)

zone_lookup: By region of the UT where the unit is located (stated in each clause; no annexure).

schemes.name: Capital Investment Subsidy - Micro & Small (new and existing industries)
schemes.clause: G.O. Ms. No. 2/2017 para 3.1(a); Industrial Policy 2016 'Incentives' item 1
schemes.notes: 40% of investment on land, building, plant & machinery (P&M incl. electrification, testing equipment, tools, jigs, moulds). Excludes transport/erection, capitalised interest, pre-operative, vehicles, office equipment; no second-hand machinery or previously used buildings. Investments on/after 01-04-2017. Apply within 1 year of commercial production. >=60% local (UT) employment required. No double subsidy for same investment. Further investments after first claim eligible up to ceiling. Still being sanctioned (e.g. G.O.Rt.No.15/DI&C dt 09-01-2025, Rs 40 lakh to a unit).

schemes.name: Capital Investment Subsidy - Women / SC / ST entrepreneurs
schemes.notes: Unit must be fully owned by the category (all partners/shareholders/directors). In lieu of (not in addition to) the general rate.
conditions: Unit wholly owned by women or SC/ST entrepreneurs

schemes.name: Subsidy to Pollution Control Equipment
schemes.notes: Requires consent to operate from Pondicherry Pollution Control Committee.

schemes.name: Interest Subsidy (new industries)
schemes.clause: G.O. Ms. No. 4/2017 para 2.1; Industrial Policy 2016 item 3
schemes.notes: 25% OF THE ANNUAL INTEREST AMOUNT PAID (not percentage points) on loans for fixed assets and working capital, from date of commercial production; max Rs 5 lakh/yr; 5 years Puducherry & Karaikal, 7 years Mahe & Yanam. Needs No Due Certificate; paid through FI.

schemes.name: Net VAT/SGST reimbursement (new industries)
schemes.notes: Policy text: 100% of net VAT/SGST paid reimbursed for micro & small, 75% for medium, 5 yrs (Puducherry/Karaikal) / 7 yrs (Mahe/Yanam). rate_by_zone is null because the policy states NO ceiling linked to fixed capital investment (share of net SGST reimbursed: micro/small 1.0, medium 0.75). Figure is in the policy document (copy hosted on investindia.gov.in), but no implementing G.O./scheme was found (the 2017 implementing G.O.s 2, 3, 4 of 2017 omit it), so operational status unconfirmed.

schemes.name: Power Subsidy (fixed power cost reimbursement)
schemes.notes: Rs 0.50 per unit for 5 years (Puducherry/Karaikal) and 7 years (Mahe/Yanam). In policy document only; no implementing G.O. found (not in G.O. Ms. No. 2 or 4 of 2017) - operational status unconfirmed.

schemes.name: Subsidy for Quality Certification
schemes.notes: Up to 3 certifications, 50% of cost, ceiling Rs 2 lakh per unit; fees of QCI-approved certification agency only; renewals not eligible.

other_benefits: Generator subsidy: 50% of cost, ceiling Rs 5 lakh per unit (G.O. Ms. No. 4/2017 para 2.2).
Employment incentive: 20% of wages of PF-covered workers up to Rs 5 lakh/yr for 5 yrs (7 yrs Mahe/Yanam), min 10 direct employees & 60% local (para 2.3).

Stamp duty: 100% reimbursement on purchase/lease/mortgage/hypothecation of land/shed/building, max Rs 25 lakh per unit (G.O. Ms. No. 5/Ind.&Com./T-8/2025-26 dt 11-08-2025, Gazette Part II No. 65 dt 18-08-2025).
Technology acquisition: 50% grant up to Rs 10 lakh (G.O. 2/2017 para 3.4).
IPR: 50% up to Rs 2 lakh domestic / Rs 5 lakh international patent (G.O. 4/2017 para 2.5).
Market development (international trade fair): 50% up to Rs 5 lakh (para 2.6).
Infrastructure subsidy for IT/ITES buildings: 30% up to Rs 1 crore (G.O. 2/2017 para 3.2).
unverifiable: Industrial Policy 2016 has no expiry date ('Validity of the Policy' section only provides for periodic review); still referenced as operative in Jan-2025 subsidy sanctions and the Aug-2025 stamp duty gazette. No newer Puducherry industrial policy found as of 17-Oct-2026.
SGST reimbursement and Rs 0.50/unit power subsidy appear only in the policy document; implementing G.O.s not found (industry.py.gov.in G.O. page unreachable from this environment).
Policy document read from copy on static.investindia.gov.in (Invest India, GoI); scheme G.O.s read from official Puducherry Gazette (styandptg.py.gov.in).
curation: py-ip2016-interest: rate is a share of the interest bill
